instruction.name: vfcvtl.d.s
instruction.description: Convert single precision floating point elements in lower half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to double precision.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vfcvtl.d.s $vr0, $vr8; vfcvtl.d.s $vr1, $vr9; vfcvtl.d.s $vr2, $vr10; vfcvtl.d.s $vr3, $vr11; vfcvtl.d.s $vr4, $vr12; vfcvtl.d.s $vr5, $vr13; vfcvtl.d.s $vr6, $vr14; vfcvtl.d.s $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1065353216; vreplgr2vr.w $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfcvtl.d.s $vr0, $vr8; vfcvtl.d.s $vr1, $vr9; vfcvtl.d.s $vr2, $vr10; vfcvtl.d.s $vr3, $vr11; vfcvtl.d.s $vr4, $vr12; vfcvtl.d.s $vr5, $vr13; vfcvtl.d.s $vr6, $vr14; vfcvtl.d.s $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 3.99 cycles. Extra counters per instruction (normalized by 8 lanes): 0xfb=2.00.

notes: LSX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
